tool_input.content:
# Plan: Prevent duplicate Fragment Title for cloned cards in M@S Studio

## Summary
When a user clones a card, the clone dialog pre-fills the title field with the original card's title, making it easy to accidentally create two cards with the same Fragment Title. This plan adds a `generateUniqueTitle` utility that auto-increments a `-N` suffix and wires it into both clone dialog components so the pre-filled title is always unique within the current tag path on first open.

## Task Description
Add uniqueness deduplication to the Fragment Title field when the clone dialog opens. Before the dialog is shown, compute a unique title by checking existing fragment titles in the current path's store and appending `-1`, `-2`, etc. until a non-colliding title is found. The user may still edit the title freely — only the initial pre-filled value is deduplicated. Manual edits are never blocked.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Why |
|------|--------|-----|
| `studio/src/utils.js` | Edit — add `generateUniqueTitle` | Shared utility for computing a unique title with numeric suffix |
| `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` | Edit — `showClone()`, `cancelClone()`, `cloneConfirmationDialog` | Primary clone flow; needs to pre-populate `titleClone` with unique title |
| `studio/src/editor-panel.js` | Edit — `showClone()`, `cancelClone()`, `cloneConfirmationDialog` | Secondary clone flow (editor panel view); same logic |
| `studio/test/utils.test.js` | Edit — add unit tests | Verify `generateUniqueTitle` handles all suffix cases |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `generateUniqueTitle` to `studio/src/utils.js`
- Export a new function `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)`:
  - Convert `existingTitles` to a `Set` for O(1) lookups.
  - If `baseTitle` is not in the set, return it unchanged.
  - Strip any trailing `-\d+` suffix from `baseTitle` to get the stem (e.g. `lucy-card-1` → stem `lucy-card`, startCounter `2`; `lucy-card` → stem `lucy-card`, startCounter `1`).
  - Iterate `${stem}-${counter}` until a candidate is not found in the set; return it.

```js
export function generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles) {
    const titleSet = new Set(existingTitles);
    if (!titleSet.has(baseTitle)) return baseTitle;
    const match = baseTitle.match(/^(.*)-(\d+)$/);
    const stem = match ? match[1] : baseTitle;
    let counter = match ? parseInt(match[2], 10) + 1 : 1;
    let candidate = `${stem}-${counter}`;
    while (titleSet.has(candidate)) {
        counter++;
        candidate = `${stem}-${counter}`;
    }
    return candidate;
}
```

### 2. Update `showClone()` in `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
- After confirming discard and before `this.showCloneDialog = true`, collect existing titles from `Store.fragments.list.data.get()` and compute the unique title:
  ```js
  const fragments = Store.fragments.list.data.get() ?? [];
  const existingTitles = fragments.map((fs) => fs.get?.()?.title).filter(Boolean);
  this.titleClone = generateUniqueTitle(this.fragment.title, existingTitles);
  ```
- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `'./utils.js'`.

### 3. Update `cancelClone()` in `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
- Reset `this.titleClone = ''` when the clone dialog is dismissed so stale state does not persist.

### 4. Update `cloneConfirmationDialog` getter in `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
- Change the `sp-textfield` value binding from `value="${this.fragment.title}"` to `value="${this.titleClone}"` so it reflects the pre-computed unique title (or whatever the user has typed).

### 5. Apply the same three changes to `studio/src/editor-panel.js`
- Same `showClone()` update: compute `this.titleClone` using `generateUniqueTitle` before showing the dialog.
- Same `cancelClone()` update: reset `this.titleClone = ''`.
- Same `cloneConfirmationDialog` update: change `sp-textfield value` binding to `this.titleClone`.
- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `'./utils.js'`.

### 6. Add unit tests in `studio/test/utils.test.js`
- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `'../src/utils.js'`.
- Test cases:
  - Title not in existing set → returns title unchanged.
  - Title in set, no numeric suffix → returns `title-1`.
  - Title in set, suffix `-1` exists → strips to stem, returns `stem-2`.
  - Multiple clones already exist (`stem-1`, `stem-2`) → returns `stem-3`.
  - Empty existing titles array → returns title unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a card whose title already exists in the current path pre-fills the clone dialog with `<title>-1`.
- If `<title>-1` also exists, pre-fills with `<title>-2`, and so on.
- Cloning a card named `lucy-card-1` pre-fills with `lucy-card-2` (strips existing suffix).
- The original card's title is never modified.
- The user can still type any title in the clone dialog; no validation blocks manual input.
- No two cards share the same Fragment Title + Path after a clone operation using the default pre-filled title.

## Validation Commands
- `node --check studio/src/utils.js`
- `node --check studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
- `node --check studio/src/editor-panel.js`
